title: Bride & Groom Wedding, 1947 US Black & White Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot showing a newlywed bride and groom standing together outdoors on their wedding day, dated June 28, 1947. The bride wears a traditional gown, veil, and hat while holding a large, lush floral bouquet. The groom wears a dark double-breasted suit with a striped necktie and floral boutonniere. An older woman, likely a relative or wedding guest, is visible in the background to the left in front of a brick building. Taken during the post-World War II era in the United States.
